claims.text: Diagnostics: TurfRad access, scan data, last scan date.
A stale course keeps its last scans
claims.note: On develop, when TurfRad reports nothing loaded since the previous processing run, the run takes a branch that deletes no stored scans and only makes sure today’s adjustments exist (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2140-2153, reached through the early return at :2575 and the "anything new?" query at TerraRadService.cs:104-134). Production has no such branch: once its seven-day re-read comes back empty it deletes the stored scans (production SpatialAdjustService.cs:2134-2146).

claims.text: When TurfRad has loaded nothing new for a course, Spatial Adjust keeps the course’s last scans, even once they are more than seven days old.
claims.note: Develop first asks TurfRad for anything loaded since the last processing run, less five minutes (TerraRadService.cs:114-119, :205-210). An empty answer ends the fetch with no results (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2575) and the run then keeps every stored scan (:2140-2153). Every run, empty or not, moves the "since" time forward (:2169), so a course that TurfRad stops updating keeps its last scans however old they become. The only deletions on develop are the replacement of a course’s scans when new data does arrive (:2812-2814) and the clean-up when TurfRad reports new data but the seven-day window is empty (:2154-2166). Production re-reads the last seven days on every run (production SpatialAdjustService.cs:2510) and deletes the stored scans once that window is empty (:2134-2146, :2817-2836).

claims.text: The stations stay in the table with their last scan date and on the map as clear pins, and under Option 2 each one still gets a modelled value and a suggestion every day.
claims.note: The dashboard lists only stations that have stored scans (SpatialAdjustService.cs:199-208), so kept scans keep the stations listed. Each station row shows its latest scan date beside its name (sa-table-card.component.html:22-25, from sa-dash-table.component.ts:241). On the map a station whose latest scan is not from today is filled transparent (sa-dash-map.component.ts:315) because the beta environment sets saShowCurrentOnly (environment.toro-beta.ts:89). A station that is not current under Option 2 is modelled (spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:184-188) and its row shows the latest adjustment’s modelled VWC in grey italics (sa-dash-table.component.ts:218, sa-table-card.component.html:29-31). The no-new-data pass writes that adjustment once a day for each station with an adjustment in the last five days (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3266-3326, window :3271-3275, once a day :3293), the dashboard attaches the newest one to each station (:239-260), and under Option 2 the suggestion is read from it (sa-algorithm.service.ts:48-49, :62-65). Each day’s adjustment feeds the next, so the chain continues for as long as TurfRad loads nothing. On production the stations drop out once their scans are deleted (production SpatialAdjustService.cs:2134-2146). The value is modelled from the older of the station’s two most recent adjustments (:3217, :3304), and a station with only one adjustment in the five-day window is modelled from zero; docs/claims/beta-surfaces.md carries that as the suggestion-held-without-new-scan candidate for the experts.

claims.text: Request latest scan data looks back only two days, so the scans stay as they are unless TurfRad has loaded new scan data in that time.
claims.note: Request latest scan data (en-us.json SPATIAL_ADJUST.REQUEST_SCAN_DATA) sets the course’s last-update time to two days ago and starts a processing run (SpatialAdjustService.cs:992, :998-999). On develop that time, less five minutes, is what the run asks TurfRad about (TerraRadService.cs:114-119, :205-210), so a course with nothing loaded in those two days takes the no-new-data branch and its scans stay as they are (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2140-2153). Production sets the same time (production SpatialAdjustService.cs:992), but there it only makes the run start; the run itself always re-reads seven days (production :2510), so the two-day look-back is develop only.

claims.text: A pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.
claims.note: True on both builds. A station’s scan is current only when its date is today, local to the course (spatial-adjust.util.ts:17-19, spatial-adjust-course.model.ts:173-182), and a pin that is not current is filled transparent, leaving its outline (sa-dash-map.component.ts:315), because saShowCurrentOnly is set in production (environment.toro-prod.ts:87) and in the beta environment (develop environment.toro-beta.ts:89). The map component is identical at the two SHAs.
